keys.name: READY_ASYNC
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM centered inside fixed bilateral support; A and B begin at unequal low phases.
keys.causal_role: establish support and asynchronous local clocks

keys.name: PRECOIL_RIGHT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM shifts right and drops while A folds across torso; feet remain fixed, beginning asymmetric anticipation.

keys.name: DEEP_COIL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Lowest/rightmost COM load; A compresses across centerline and knees carry visible preparation before release.

keys.name: A_RELEASE_SNAP
keys.motion_arc_root_note: A snaps to high-left extreme while COM springs toward center; B has not yet reached latch phase.

keys.name: B_APEX_READ
keys.motion_arc_root_note: B reaches high-right apex while A decelerates down; COM counter-shifts left so the future freeze silhouette is already readable.

keys.name: FREEZE_B_LATCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Scoped event freezes B at already-established apex; no BASE reset and no new B geometry.

keys.name: A_COUNTERSWEEP_B_HELD
keys.motion_arc_root_note: B stays pinned high while A sweeps low-left and COM deepens left counterweight; knees absorb continuing motion.
keys.causal_role: prove nonparticipant continuation during B freeze

keys.name: A_OVERSHOOT_DECEL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: A passes its low target into a near-ground overshoot, then begins to lose speed; B remains high and frozen.

keys.name: RELEASE_B
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Release changes only B authority; A and COM are already recovering, so no idle reset or global phase restart occurs.

keys.name: B_PHASE_DEBT_WHIP
keys.motion_arc_root_note: B whips from frozen high to low-right extreme in one authored spike, visibly spending accumulated phase debt.

keys.name: BODY_CATCH_RIGHT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM follows the B whip into a rightward catch and knee compression; force consequence outlasts the one-tick phase spike.

keys.name: B_REBOUND_A_LAG
keys.motion_arc_root_note: B rebounds upward while A trails low; COM returns toward center but remains right-biased, preserving secondary lag.
keys.causal_role: secondary lag and readable consequence hold

keys.name: RESTACK_OFFSET
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Body restacks one cell left of READY with B still slightly high; recovery is paid before next loop rather than teleporting to idle.

compile.connector_rule: Only explicit bridge_to_next instructions interpolate authored joint geometry. Feet/support remain fixed. Event boundaries hard-cut. Curved quadratic control bias avoids straight-line tweening and cannot change support or clock authority.

tango.inspection: Fresh actual-render inspection of every frame in one complete 45-frame semantic loop from the deterministically compiled MP4, using a 45-frame render contact sheet; source art absent.

iterations.judgment: Actual render reads READY hold -> rightward/drop precoiling -> deeper stored-energy coil -> one-frame A release -> readable B apex -> one-frame scoped latch -> held-high B against continuing low-left A/COM counter-sweep -> A overshoot/deceleration -> one-frame release -> one-frame B phase-debt whip -> curved decelerating body catch -> B rebound with A lag -> offset restack. Feet remain fixed, COM stays inside bilateral support, connective spacing is curved/asymmetric, and recovery pays debt instead of reverse-interpolating or snapping to idle.

noodle_queen.judgment: TASTE + FUNCTION + CONTEMPT PASS after Tango PASS: the deep right coil, high frozen B versus low traveling A, one-beat debt whip, and rightward body catch are memorable and rhythm-specific. Force and intent remain legible without ornamental motion; support and clock causality stay coherent; the offset recovery is economical rather than cheap.
